tools.description: Delete a draft from the application.

requiredParameters.name: draftId
requiredParameters.description: The alphanumeric identifier of the draft to delete.

tools.description: Creates a new request or ticket in the system.
intentExamples: create a request for an event
open a new ticket for an event

requiredParameters.name: eventDate
requiredParameters.description: The event date, preserving the format provided by the user.

requiredParameters.name: eventCity
requiredParameters.description: The city where the event will take place.

requiredParameters.name: eventCountry
requiredParameters.description: The country where the event will take place.

requiredParameters.name: primarySpeaker
requiredParameters.description: The primary speaker's name or person identifier.

requiredParameters.name: eventSecurityList
requiredParameters.description: The companies or securities associated with the event, as a list of names written exactly as the user gave them (for example: Microsoft Corp, SpaceX, 1Password).
